_note: Voice per character for recorded [REC] lines. 'voice_id' set = ready to render. 'design' = brief for ElevenLabs voice design (eleven_ttv_v3); run `yap_voice.py design`, listen, then `yap_voice.py pick <char> <n>`. Briefs come from docs/cast-bible.md. Every accent needs native-speaker review before launch.

pip.design: A bright, friendly young-adult voice, gender-neutral, mid pitch, with an audible smile. Curious, easily delighted, a little breathless when excited, small natural hesitations when thinking. Clear, neutral international English accent. Warm and playful but not childlike or cartoonish.

linh.design: A Vietnamese woman in her early thirties speaking fluent, confident English with a natural Vietnamese accent. Warm, calm and unhurried, steady and encouraging, like a kind neighbour who has been where you are.

mei.design: A Singaporean woman in her late thirties speaking Singaporean English with a natural Singaporean accent. Energetic, quick, funny and generous, laughs easily, brisk rhythm, a café owner who feeds everyone.

sol.design: A Filipino professional in their late twenties speaking clear, polite Filipino English with a natural Filipino accent. Bright, precise and upbeat, very friendly, quietly funny, sounds great running a meeting.

hank.design: A big, loud American man in his late forties with a fast General American accent. Gravelly but friendly, deal-loving and impatient, talks quickly, secretly soft-hearted. Pushy salesman energy, never menacing.

nell.design: An Australian woman in her late thirties with a natural Australian accent. Relaxed, warm and practical, mid-low pitch, wry and unflappable, an inn keeper who solves everything with a cup of tea and a list.

bea.design: A cheerful British woman in her late forties with a warm regional English accent. Brisk, chatty and affectionate, a smile in every line, a bus driver who calls everyone 'love' and always leaves on time.

dex.design: An American man in his mid-forties with a clear General American accent. Calm, deep and warm, measured and unhurried, a fair and encouraging interviewer who makes people feel at ease. Professional but friendly, reassuring, speaks clearly with natural pauses, never stiff or salesy.
